_comment: Phase 33.5 STRIDE checklist snapshot. Machine-readable mirror of reference/gdd-threat-model.md: the 5 in-scope components and the residual-risk -> closing-plan map. A regression that re-opens a closed residual (or drops a component) trips test/suite/phase-33-5-baseline.test.cjs.

residuals.risk: WS binds 0.0.0.0 by default (listen, no host) + timing-unsafe != token compare
GDD_STATE_PATH path traversal (no guard) + no payload-size cap + un-tightened tool schemas
Full process.env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GH_TOKEN) leaks to spawned peers (acp/asp)
Outbound egress sites have no machine-readable allowlist + no CI gate
Secret-scan misses Gemini AIza / GitHub fine-grained github_pat_ / GitHub server gh[sour]_ tokens

already_mitigated.surface: Outbound via gh CLI only; frozen destination; dual-surface kill-switch
Bearer-token auth on every WS upgrade + >=8-char token rule
16 MiB un-newlined-stdout DoS cap on untrusted peer output
Deep-walk secret scrub of every event payload at serialize time
